scientific_limitations: For strongly connected, loopless, unweighted directed graphs with patchwise bidegrees ((1,2),(2,1),(1,1),(1,1)), exactly five five-arc realizations yield three Perron roots. Applies to linear stability of the extinction state in a specified deterministic homogeneous occupancy model, not a finite-state stochastic persistence guarantee.
